# Anya Razina. I use Restream Studio for my monthly show, which features live product demos and Q&As. It helps me create beautiful layouts for guest speakers and media—even with limited prep time and basic design skills. My audience loves the show because I can highlight their comments on screen and make everyone feel included. Repurposing is magic too: I get viral clips after each event and can pre-record and schedule demos to stream live. It's easy to use, makes me look professional, and drives real results—my audience turns into leads and active customers after every show. #### What's great. restream studio (3)custom layouts and overlays (2)highlighting comments (1)repurposing content (4)pre-record and schedule (1)easy-to-use UI (3).

Anglomova looks like a breath of fresh air for anyone stuck in that endless loop of Duolingo streaks without real progress. Finally something that feels tailored instead of one-size-fits-all. Quick note: the progress dashboards are super motivating with those visual skill bars, but it'd be awesome if you could add a quick audio export feature for reviewing my speaking practice on the go (like Spotify-style clips).
